caption:
Slowly, over time, AND WITH LOTS OF REPETITION... I’m teaching him that CALM is what gets him what he wants. Not yelling, demanding, and forcing things. It’s a balance of letting his voice be heard AND being respectful of others and not crossing the line. I’m trying to teach him that it’s OK to feel frustrated when things don’t go our way, but it’s how he communicates that matters.

Comment YES is this is similar to how you speak to your little ones. Lemme know if you have any questions!
